description: Save a workspace: the apps of a desktop setup, where each window goes, and what each app should open. Pass 'items' to describe the arrangement, or omit them to snapshot the windows exactly as they are on screen right now. Saving over an existing name replaces it. Saved workspaces are listed in get_state, with their full contents.

app.description: App name as it appears in get_state, e.g. 'Safari'

args.description: Launch arguments. Many Mac apps ignore these; prefer 'urls'

bundle_id.description: Bundle identifier, e.g. 'com.apple.Safari'. Required to launch an app that is not running

minimized.description: Minimize the window once it is in place

screen_uuid.description: Display UUID from a saved workspace; survives monitors being unplugged, unlike the index

title.description: Prefer windows whose title contains this substring

urls.description: Files, folders or URLs this app opens when the workspace launches it, e.g. a project folder for an editor or a set of tabs for a browser

window_index.description: Which window of that app, when the workspace holds several of them

move_existing.description: When true (the default), an app that is already running has its windows moved into place. When false, running apps are left alone and only missing apps are launched.

name: save_workspace
